title.zh: 卷一百三十二 列傳第十九: 杭忽思 步魯合答 玉哇失 麥里 探馬赤 拔都兒 昂吉兒 哈剌䚟 沙全 帖木兒不花
title.en: Volume 132 Biographies 19: Hanghusi, Buluheda, Yuwashi, Maili, Tanmachi, Badou'er, Angji'er, Haladai, Sha Quan, Tiemu'erbuhua
title.raw: 卷一百三十二 列傳第十九: 杭忽思 步魯合答 玉哇失 麥里 探馬赤 拔都兒 昂吉兒 哈剌䚟 沙全 帖木兒不花 Volume 132 Biographies 19: Hanghusi, Buluheda, Yuwashi, Maili, Tanmachi, Badou'er, Angji'er, Haladai, Sha Quan, Tiemu'erbuhua

sentences.zh: 杭忽思

translations.literal: Hanghusi
translations.idiomatic: Hanghusi

sentences.zh: 杭忽思，阿速氏，主阿速國。

translations.literal: Hanghusi, of the Asu clan, ruled the Asu state.
translations.idiomatic: Hanghusi, of the Asu clan, was lord of the Asu state.

sentences.zh: 太宗兵至其境，杭忽思率衆來降，賜名拔都兒，錫以金符，命領其土民。

translations.literal: When Taizong's army reached his territory, Hanghusi led the multitude in surrender. He was granted the name Badou'er, bestowed a gold tally, and ordered to govern his local populace.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizong's army reached his lands, Hanghusi led his people in surrender. He was given the name Badou'er, awarded a gold tally, and appointed to govern his own subjects.

sentences.zh: 尋奉旨選阿速軍千人，及其長子阿塔赤扈駕親征。

translations.literal: Soon he received an imperial order to select one thousand Asu troops, and together with his eldest son Atach accompanied the emperor on a personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered to select one thousand Asu soldiers, and he and his eldest son Atach accompanied the emperor on campaign.

sentences.zh: 既還，阿塔赤入直宿衛。

translations.literal: After returning, Atach entered constant duty in the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: After they returned, Atach was assigned to the palace guard on standing duty.

sentences.zh: 杭忽思還國，道遇敵人，戰歿，敕其妻外麻思領兵守其國。

translations.literal: Hanghusi returned to his state. On the road he met enemies and died in battle. An edict ordered his wife Waimasi to lead troops and defend the state.
translations.idiomatic: Hanghusi was returning home when he encountered enemies on the road and was killed in battle. An edict then ordered his wife Waimasi to lead troops and hold the state.

sentences.zh: 外麻思躬擐甲冑，平叛亂，後以次子按法普代之。

translations.literal: Waimasi personally donned armor, pacified rebellions, and later the second son Anfapu replaced her.
translations.idiomatic: Waimasi herself put on armor, put down the rebellions, and was later replaced by her second son Anfapu.

sentences.zh: 阿塔赤從憲宗征西川軍于釣魚山，與宋兵戰有功，帝親飲以酒，賞以白金。

translations.literal: Atach followed Xianzong in the campaign against Xichuan, encamping at Diaoyu Mountain. He rendered meritorious service fighting Song troops. The emperor personally gave him wine to drink and rewarded him with white gold.
translations.idiomatic: Atach followed Emperor Xianzong in the campaign against Sichuan and encamped at Diaoyu Mountain. He distinguished himself in battle against Song forces, and the emperor personally gave him wine and rewarded him with silver.

sentences.zh: 阿里不哥叛，從也里可征之，至寧夏，與阿藍荅兒、渾都海戰，率先赴敵，矢中其腹，不懼，世祖聞而嘉之，賞以白金，召入宿衛。

translations.literal: When Ariq Böke rebelled, he followed Yeke in the punitive expedition. At Ningxia he fought Aran and Köden, charging ahead of all others. An arrow struck his belly, but he did not flinch. Shizu heard of this and commended him, rewarded him with white gold, and summoned him into the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Ariq Böke rebelled, Atach followed Yeke to suppress him. At Ningxia he fought Aran and Köden, leading the charge. An arrow struck him in the belly, yet he did not waver. Emperor Shizu praised him for this, rewarded him with silver, and summoned him into the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 中統二年，扈駕親征阿里不哥，追至失木里禿之地，以功復賞白金。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Zhongtong era, he accompanied the emperor on the personal campaign against Ariq Böke, pursuing him to Shimu Litou, and was again rewarded with white gold for his service.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhongtong, he accompanied the emperor on campaign against Ariq Böke, pursuing him to Shimu Litou, and was again rewarded with silver for his achievements.

sentences.zh: 三年，從征李璮，平之。

translations.literal: In the third year, he followed the campaign against Li Tan and helped pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the campaign against Li Tan and helped put down the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 至元五年，奉旨同不荅台領兵南征，攻破金剛臺。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the Zhiyuan era, by imperial order he joined Budat in leading troops on the southern campaign and captured Jingang Platform.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan, by imperial order he and Budat led troops south, capturing Jingang Platform.

sentences.zh: 六年，從攻安慶府，戰有功。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he joined the attack on Anqing Prefecture and rendered meritorious service in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he took part in the assault on Anqing Prefecture and distinguished himself in battle.

sentences.zh: 七年，從下五河口。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he joined in capturing Wuhekou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he helped capture Wuhekou.

sentences.zh: 十一年，從下沿江諸郡，戍鎮巢，民不堪命，宋降將洪福以計乘醉而殺之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he joined in capturing the prefectures along the Yangtze and was stationed at garrison Chao. The people could not bear the oppression. The Song defector general Hong Fu used a stratagem to kill him while he was drunk.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he helped capture the Yangtze river counties and was left to garrison Chaoxian. The people could not endure the hardship. The Song defector Hong Fu devised a plot and killed him while he was drunk.

sentences.zh: 世祖憫其死，賜其家白金五百兩、鈔三千五百貫，併鎮巢降民一千五百三十九戶，且命其子伯荅兒襲千戶，佩金符。

translations.literal: Shizu took pity on his death and granted his family five hundred taels of white gold and three thousand five hundred strings of paper money. He also assigned the surrendered populace of Zhenchao, one thousand five hundred thirty-nine households, and ordered his son Bo'erd to inherit the command of a thousand-household unit with a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu mourned his death and granted his family five hundred taels of silver and three thousand five hundred strings of paper money, along with one thousand five hundred thirty-nine surrendered households from Chaoxian. He also ordered Atach's son Bo'erd to inherit the thousand-household command and wear a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 時失烈吉叛，詔伯荅兒領阿速軍一千往征之，與甕吉剌只兒瓦台軍戰于押里，復與藥木忽兒軍戰于禿剌及斡魯歡之地。

translations.literal: When Sileji rebelled, an edict ordered Bo'erd to lead one thousand Asu troops to campaign against him. He fought Onggirad Jirwat's army at Yali, then fought Yimuhu's army at Tula and Wolu Huan.
translations.idiomatic: When Sileji rebelled, Bo'erd was ordered to lead one thousand Asu troops against him. He fought Jirwat's army at Yali, then battled Yimuhu's forces at Tula and Wolu Huan.

sentences.zh: 十五年春，至伯牙之地，與赤憐軍合戰。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifteenth year, he reached Boya territory and joined battle with the Chilin army.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year he reached Boya and fought the Chilin army.

sentences.zh: 五月，駐兵呵剌牙，與外剌台、寬赤哥思等軍合戰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, he encamped at Halaya and joined battle with the armies of Walatai, Kuanchiges, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he encamped at Halaya and fought the armies of Walatai, Kuanchiges, and others.

sentences.zh: 其大將塔思不花樹木為柵，積石為城，以拒大軍。

translations.literal: Their general Tasibuha built palisades of trees and walls of piled stone to resist the main army.
translations.idiomatic: Their general Tasibuha built wooden palisades and piled stone walls to hold off the main force.

sentences.zh: 伯荅兒督勇士先登，拔之，伯荅兒矢中右股，別吉里迷失以其功聞，賞白金。

translations.literal: Bo'erd directed brave warriors to scale first and captured the position. Bo'erd was struck by an arrow in the right thigh. Beglimishi reported his achievement, and he was rewarded with white gold.
translations.idiomatic: Bo'erd urged his bravest men to scale the defenses first and took the position. He himself was struck in the right thigh by an arrow. Beglimishi reported his feat, and he was rewarded with silver.

sentences.zh: 二十年，授虎符、定遠大將軍、後衛親軍都指揮使，兼領阿速軍，充阿速拔都達魯花赤。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he was granted a tiger tally, the title General Dingyuan, and appointed Commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Guard, concurrently commanding Asu troops and serving as Chief Administrator of the Asu Batu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was granted a tiger tally and the title General Dingyuan, appointed Commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Guard, placed in command of the Asu army, and made Chief Administrator of the Asu Batu.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，征別失八里，軍于亦里渾察罕兒之地，與禿呵、不早麻軍戰，有功。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, on the campaign against Beshbalik, he encamped at Yili Hun Chahan'er and fought the Tuha and Buzao Ma armies with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, campaigning against Beshbalik, he encamped at Yili Hun Chahan'er and distinguished himself in battle against the Tuha and Buzao Ma forces.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，征杭海，敵勢甚盛，大軍乏食，其母乃咬真輸己帑及畜牧等給軍食，世祖聞而嘉之，賜予甚厚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, on the campaign against Hanghai, the enemy was very strong and the main army lacked food. His mother Niaojin contributed her own treasury funds and livestock to supply the army. Shizu heard of this and commended her, granting generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, during the campaign against Hanghai, the enemy was formidable and the army ran short of provisions. His mother Niaojin contributed her own funds and livestock to feed the troops. Emperor Shizu praised her for this and granted her lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 大德四年，伯荅兒卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Dade era, Bo'erd died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dade, Bo'erd died.

sentences.zh: 長子斡羅思，由宿衛仕至隆鎮衛都指揮使；

translations.literal: The eldest son Woluosi rose from the palace guard to Commander of the Longzhen Guard;
translations.idiomatic: The eldest son Woluosi rose through the palace guard to become Commander of the Longzhen Guard;

sentences.zh: 次子福定，襲職，官懷遠大將軍，尋改右阿速衛達魯花赤，兼管後衛軍。

translations.literal: The second son Fuding inherited the post, holding the rank General Huaiyuan, and soon became Chief Administrator of the Right Asu Guard, concurrently managing the Rear Guard army.
translations.idiomatic: The second son Fuding inherited the office as General Huaiyuan, and soon became Chief Administrator of the Right Asu Guard while also overseeing the Rear Guard army.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，兄都丹充右阿速衛都指揮使；

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Zhida era, his elder brother Doudan became Commander of the Right Asu Guard;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhida, his elder brother Doudan became Commander of the Right Asu Guard;

sentences.zh: 福定復職後衛，陞樞密同僉，命領軍一千守遷民鎮，尋授定遠大將軍、僉樞密院事、後衛親軍都指揮使，提調右衛阿速達魯花赤。

translations.literal: Fuding resumed his Rear Guard post, was promoted to Associate Chief of the Privy Council, and was ordered to lead one thousand troops to guard Qianmin Garrison. Soon he was granted General Dingyuan, Privy Council Associate, Commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Guard, and supervising Chief Administrator of the Right Guard Asu.
translations.idiomatic: Fuding returned to the Rear Guard, was promoted to Associate Chief of the Privy Council, and was ordered to lead one thousand troops to garrison Qianmin. Soon he was made General Dingyuan, Privy Council Associate, Commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Guard, and supervising Chief Administrator of the Right Guard Asu.

sentences.zh: 二年，進資善大夫、同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was advanced to Grand Master for Excellent Advice and Vice Minister of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was promoted to Grand Master for Excellent Advice and Vice Minister of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 後至元間，進知樞密院事。

translations.literal: During the late Zhiyuan period, he was advanced to Minister of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: During the late Zhiyuan period he was promoted to Minister of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 步魯合荅

translations.literal: Buluheda
translations.idiomatic: Buluheda

sentences.zh: 至元二年，車里以老疾，不任事，諸王阿只吉命步魯合荅代領其軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Zhiyuan era, Cheli was old and ill and could not perform his duties. Prince Aziji ordered Buluheda to take command of his army in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiyuan, Cheli was aged and infirm and could no longer serve. Prince Aziji ordered Buluheda to take command of his army in his place.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，制授管軍千戶，佩金符。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of the Zhiyuan era, by regulation he was appointed commander of a thousand-household military unit and granted a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, by regulation he was appointed commander of a thousand-household unit and granted a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 宋將昝萬壽攻成都，僉省嚴忠範遣步魯合荅將兵七百人禦之于沙坎，流矢中右頰，拔矢，戰愈力，大敗其軍。

translations.literal: Song general Zan Wanshou attacked Chengdu. Minister Yan Zhongfan dispatched Buluheda with seven hundred troops to resist him at Shakan. A stray arrow struck his right cheek. He pulled out the arrow and fought with even greater force, inflicting a great defeat on the enemy army.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song general Zan Wanshou attacked Chengdu, Minister Yan Zhongfan sent Buluheda with seven hundred men to meet him at Shakan. A stray arrow struck him in the right cheek; he pulled it out and fought all the harder, routing the enemy army.

sentences.zh: 十一年，行院汪田哥以兵圍嘉定，步魯合荅即率其衆攻九頂山，破之，嘉定降。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Mobile Court Wang Tiange besieged Jiading with troops. Buluheda immediately led his forces to attack Jiuding Mountain, captured it, and Jiading surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Mobile Court Wang Tiange besieged Jiading. Buluheda immediately led his men to assault Jiuding Mountain, took it, and Jiading surrendered.

sentences.zh: 進攻重慶，宋軍突圍出走銅鑼峽，行院忽敦遣步魯合荅追之，至廣羊埧，斬首二百級。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Chongqing, Song troops broke out and fled through Tongluo Gorge. Mobile Court Hudun dispatched Buluheda in pursuit. At Guangyang Bu they beheaded two hundred enemy soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing against Chongqing, Song forces broke out and fled through Tongluo Gorge. Mobile Court Hudun sent Buluheda in pursuit, and at Guangyang Bu they cut down two hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 瀘州叛，還軍討之，步魯合荅以所部兵攻寶子寨，歲餘不下，乃造雲梯先登，急擊，遂破之，殺虜殆盡。

translations.literal: When Luzhou rebelled, he turned back to suppress it. Buluheda attacked Baozi Stockade with his own troops. After more than a year he could not capture it, so he built siege ladders, scaled first himself, and pressed the attack vigorously, finally breaking the stockade and killing nearly all the defenders.
translations.idiomatic: When Luzhou rebelled, the army turned back to suppress it. Buluheda attacked Baozi Stockade with his own troops. After more than a year without success, he built siege ladders, climbed first himself, and pressed the assault until the stockade fell and nearly all the defenders were killed.

sentences.zh: 十六年，取重慶，以功遷武略將軍、征行元帥。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Chongqing was taken. For his service he was promoted to General Wulue and Campaign Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Chongqing was taken, and for his achievements he was promoted to General Wulue and Campaign Marshal.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命統蒙古探馬赤軍千人從征金齒蠻，平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he was ordered to command one thousand Mongol Tumet troops on the campaign against the Jinci tribes and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to command one thousand Mongol Tumet troops in the campaign against the Jinci tribes and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 都元帥蒙古歹征羅必甸，步魯合荅率游兵先行，江水暴溢，率衆泅水而渡，去城三百步而營。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Menggudai campaigned against Luobidian. Buluheda led vanguard scouts ahead. The river waters surged. He led his troops swimming across and encamped three hundred paces from the city.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Marshal Menggudai campaigned against Luobidian, Buluheda led the vanguard scouts ahead. The river rose in flood, and he swam across with his men, encamping three hundred paces from the city.

sentences.zh: 居七日，諸軍會城下，乃進攻之，步魯合荅先登，拔其城，遂屠之。

translations.literal: After seven days, all armies gathered beneath the city walls and advanced the attack. Buluheda scaled first, captured the city, and then slaughtered its inhabitants.
translations.idiomatic: After seven days the armies gathered beneath the walls and pressed the assault. Buluheda was first to scale the wall, took the city, and then put its people to the sword.

sentences.zh: 又從征八百媳婦國，至車厘，車厘者，其酋長所居也。

translations.literal: He also followed the campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives kingdom, reaching Cheli, which was where its chieftain resided.
translations.idiomatic: He also joined the campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives kingdom, reaching Cheli, the seat of its chieftain.

sentences.zh: 諸王闊闊命步魯合荅將游騎三百往招之降，不聽，進兵攻之，都鎮撫侯正死焉。

translations.literal: Prince Kuoku ordered Buluheda to lead three hundred mounted scouts to summon them to surrender. They refused. He advanced to attack, and Regional Pacifier Hou Zheng died there.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kuoku ordered Buluheda to lead three hundred mounted scouts to summon them to surrender. They refused, and when he advanced to attack, Regional Pacifier Hou Zheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 步魯合荅毀其北門木，遂入其寨，其地悉平。

translations.literal: Buluheda destroyed the wooden north gate, entered their stockade, and pacified the entire region.
translations.idiomatic: Buluheda broke through the wooden north gate, entered their stockade, and pacified the whole region.

sentences.zh: 賜金虎符，授懷遠大將軍、雲南萬戶府達魯花赤，卒。

translations.literal: He was granted a gold tiger tally and appointed General Huaiyuan and Chief Administrator of the Yunnan Myriad-Household Command. He died.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted a gold tiger tally and appointed General Huaiyuan and Chief Administrator of the Yunnan Myriad-Household Command, and later died.

sentences.zh: 子忙古不花，襲管軍千戶。

translations.literal: His son Mangubuhua inherited the command of the thousand-household military unit.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mangubuhua inherited the thousand-household command.

sentences.zh: 初，按主奴三子：長車里，次黑子，次帖木兒。

translations.literal: Originally, Anzhun had three sons: the eldest Cheli, the second Heizi, and the third Timur.
translations.idiomatic: Anzhun had three sons: the eldest Cheli, the second Heizi, and the third Timur.

sentences.zh: 黑子別賜金符，為奧魯元帥，兼文州吐蕃達魯花赤，卒。

translations.literal: Heizi was separately granted a gold tally and served as Ordu Marshal, concurrently as Chief Administrator of Wenzhou Tibetans. He died.
translations.idiomatic: Heizi was separately granted a gold tally and served as Ordu Marshal and Chief Administrator of the Wenzhou Tibetans, and later died.

sentences.zh: 其子那懷幼，以帖木兒攝其官。

translations.literal: His son Nahua was young, so Timur acted in his stead in the office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Nahua was still young, so Timur served in his stead.

sentences.zh: 那懷長，解職授之，遂改授帖木兒隨路拔都萬戶，後移鎮重慶，卒。

translations.literal: When Nahua came of age, the acting appointment was relinquished to him. Timur was then reassigned as Route Batu Myriad-Household Commander, later transferred to garrison Chongqing, and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Nahua came of age, the office was formally transferred to him. Timur was then reassigned as Route Batu Myriad-Household Commander, later transferred to garrison Chongqing, and died there.

sentences.zh: 玉哇失

translations.literal: Yuwashi
translations.idiomatic: Yuwashi

sentences.zh: 玉哇失，阿速人。

translations.literal: Yuwashi was an Asu man.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwashi was an Asu.

sentences.zh: 父也烈拔都兒，從其國主來歸，太宗命充宿衛。

translations.literal: His father Yelie Badou'er came to submit with their state's ruler. Taizong ordered him to serve in the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yelie Badou'er came to submit with their state's ruler, and Emperor Taizong appointed him to the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 歲戊午，從憲宗征蜀，為游兵，前行至重慶，戰數有功。

translations.literal: In the wuwu year, he followed Xianzong in the campaign against Shu as a mobile scout, advancing ahead to Chongqing and rendering repeated merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the wuwu year he followed Emperor Xianzong in the campaign against Shu as a mobile scout, advancing ahead to Chongqing and winning repeated distinction in battle.

sentences.zh: 嘗出獵遇虎於隘，下馬搏虎，虎張吻欲噬之，以手探虎口，抉其舌，拔所佩刀刺而殺之。

translations.literal: Once while hunting he encountered a tiger in a narrow pass. He dismounted to grapple with the tiger. The tiger opened its jaws to bite him. He reached his hand into the tiger's mouth, pulled out its tongue, drew the knife at his belt, and stabbed it to death.
translations.idiomatic: Once while hunting he met a tiger in a narrow pass. He dismounted to fight it hand to hand. The tiger opened its jaws to bite him, but he thrust his hand into its mouth, pulled out its tongue, drew the knife at his belt, and stabbed it to death.

sentences.zh: 帝壯其勇，賞黃金五十兩，別立阿速一軍，使領其衆。

translations.literal: The emperor admired his bravery, rewarded him with fifty taels of gold, established a separate Asu army, and had him command its troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor admired his courage, rewarded him with fifty taels of gold, established a separate Asu army, and put him in command of it.

sentences.zh: 從世祖征阿里不哥，又從親王哈必失征李璮，俱有功，賜金符，授本軍千戶。

translations.literal: He followed Shizu in the campaign against Ariq Böke, and followed Prince Habishi in the campaign against Li Tan, both with merit. He was granted a gold tally and appointed commander of his thousand-household unit.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Emperor Shizu against Ariq Böke and Prince Habishi against Li Tan, distinguishing himself in both campaigns. He was granted a gold tally and appointed commander of his thousand-household unit.

sentences.zh: 從下襄陽，又從下沿江諸城，宋洪安撫既降復叛，誘其入城宴，乘醉殺之。

translations.literal: He joined in capturing Xiangyang and the cities along the Yangtze. The Song pacification commissioner Hong had surrendered then rebelled again. He lured Yelie into the city for a banquet and killed him while he was drunk.
translations.idiomatic: He helped capture Xiangyang and the Yangtze river cities. The Song pacification commissioner Hong had surrendered and then rebelled again; he lured Yelie into the city for a banquet and killed him while he was drunk.

sentences.zh: 長子也速歹兒代領其軍，從攻揚州，中流矢卒。

translations.literal: The eldest son Yesudai'er took command of the army in his stead and followed the attack on Yangzhou, but died when struck by a stray arrow.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Yesudai'er took command of the army and joined the assault on Yangzhou, but was killed by a stray arrow.

sentences.zh: 玉哇失襲父職，為阿速軍千戶。

translations.literal: Yuwashi inherited his father's post as commander of the Asu thousand-household unit.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwashi inherited his father's post as commander of the Asu thousand-household unit.

sentences.zh: 從丞相伯顏平宋，賜巢縣二千五十二戶。

translations.literal: He followed Chancellor Bayan in pacifying Song and was granted two thousand fifty-two households in Chao County.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Chancellor Bayan in the pacification of Song and was granted two thousand fifty-two households in Chaoxian.

sentences.zh: 只兒瓦歹叛，率所部兵擊之，至懷魯哈都，擒其將失剌察兒，斬于軍，其衆悉平。

translations.literal: When Zhi'erwadai rebelled, he led his troops to attack him. At Huailuhadu he captured the general Shilicha'er, executed him in camp, and pacified all his followers.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhi'erwadai rebelled, Yuwashi led his troops against him. At Huailuhadu he captured the general Shilicha'er, executed him before the army, and pacified all his followers.

sentences.zh: 諸王和林及失剌等叛，從皇子北安王討之，至斡耳罕河，無舟，躍馬涉流而渡，俘獲甚衆。

translations.literal: When Prince Helin and Shila rebelled, he followed Prince Bei'an in suppressing them. At the Orqan River there were no boats. He leaped on his horse and crossed the current, capturing many prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Helin and Shila rebelled, he followed Prince Bei'an to suppress them. At the Orqan River there were no boats, so he spurred his horse into the current and crossed, taking many prisoners.

sentences.zh: 時北安王方戰失利，陷敵陣中，玉哇失從諸王藥木忽兒追至金山，王乃得脫歸。

translations.literal: At that time Prince Bei'an was losing the battle and trapped in the enemy formation. Yuwashi followed Prince Yimuhu in pursuit to Jinshan, and the prince was thus able to escape.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Prince Bei'an was losing the battle and trapped in the enemy lines. Yuwashi followed Prince Yimuhu in pursuit to Jinshan, and the prince was thus able to escape.

sentences.zh: 賞白金五十兩、鈔二千五百貫，改賜金虎符，進定遠大將軍、前衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: He was rewarded with fifty taels of white gold and two thousand five hundred strings of paper money, granted a gold tiger tally in replacement, and advanced to General Dingyuan and Commander of the Front Guard Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was rewarded with fifty taels of silver and two thousand five hundred strings of paper money, granted a gold tiger tally, and promoted to General Dingyuan and Commander of the Front Guard Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 諸王乃顏叛，世祖親征，玉哇失為前鋒。

translations.literal: When Prince Nayan rebelled, Shizu personally campaigned. Yuwashi served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Nayan rebelled, Emperor Shizu personally took the field, and Yuwashi served as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 乃顏遣哈丹領兵萬人來拒，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Nayan sent Hadan with ten thousand troops to resist. Yuwashi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Nayan sent Hadan with ten thousand men to resist him, and Yuwashi defeated them.

sentences.zh: 追至不里古都伯塔哈之地，乃顏兵號十萬，玉哇失陷陣力戰，又敗之，追至失列門林，遂擒乃顏。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Buligu Dubtaha, Nayan's army was said to number one hundred thousand. Yuwashi fought trapped in the enemy formation, defeated them again, pursued to Shiliemenlin, and captured Nayan.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to Buligu Dubtaha, he faced Nayan's army, said to number one hundred thousand. Yuwashi fought deep in the enemy lines, defeated them again, pursued to Shiliemenlin, and captured Nayan.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其功，賜金帶、只孫、錢幣甚厚。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his achievement and granted him generously: a gold belt, ceremonial robes, and money.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his achievement and rewarded him lavishly with a gold belt, ceremonial robes, and money.

sentences.zh: 乃顏餘黨塔不歹、金家奴聚兵滅捏該，從大軍討平之。

translations.literal: Nayan's remaining followers Tabudai and Jinjianu gathered troops at Mienie Gai. Yuwashi followed the main army to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Nayan's remaining followers Tabudai and Jinjianu gathered troops at Mienie Gai, and Yuwashi joined the main army in suppressing them.

sentences.zh: 既而哈丹復叛於曲連江，追擊其軍，渡河而遁。

translations.literal: Soon after, Hadan rebelled again at Qulian River. Yuwashi pursued his army. Hadan crossed the river and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Hadan rebelled again at Qulian River. Yuwashi pursued his army, but Hadan crossed the river and fled.

sentences.zh: 又與海都將八憐、帖里哥歹、必里察等戰於亦必兒失必兒之地，戰屢捷。

translations.literal: He also fought Qaidu's generals Baling, Teligedai, and Bilicha at Yibiershibi'er, winning repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: He also fought Qaidu's generals Baling, Teligedai, and Bilicha at Yibiershibi'er and won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 成宗時在潛邸，帝以海都連年犯邊，命出鎮金山，玉哇失率所部在行。

translations.literal: When Chengzong was in the latent residence, the emperor, because Qaidu had violated the borders year after year, ordered him to garrison Jinshan. Yuwashi led his troops on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: While Chengzong was still heir apparent, the emperor, because Qaidu had raided the borders year after year, ordered him to garrison Jinshan, and Yuwashi led his troops on campaign.

sentences.zh: 從皇子闊闊出、丞相朶兒朶懷擊海都軍，突陣而入，大破之。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Kuochu and Chancellor Duo'erduohuai in attacking Qaidu's army, broke through the enemy formation, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Prince Kuochu and Chancellor Duo'erduohuai in the attack on Qaidu's army, broke through the enemy lines, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 復從諸王藥木忽兒、丞相朶兒朶懷擊海都將八憐，八憐敗。

translations.literal: He again followed Prince Yimuhu and Chancellor Duo'erduohuai in attacking Qaidu's general Baling. Baling was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: He again served under Prince Yimuhu and Chancellor Duo'erduohuai in the attack on Qaidu's general Baling and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 海都復以禿苦馬領精兵三萬人直趨撒剌思河，欲據險以襲我師。

translations.literal: Qaidu again sent Tukuma with thirty thousand elite troops to strike directly at the Salasi River, intending to seize advantageous terrain and ambush our army.
translations.idiomatic: Qaidu again sent Tukuma with thirty thousand elite troops straight toward the Salasi River, intending to seize a strong position and ambush our army.

sentences.zh: 玉哇失率善射者三百人守其隘，注矢以射，竟全軍而歸。

translations.literal: Yuwashi led three hundred skilled archers to hold the pass, showered arrows upon the enemy, and the entire army returned safely.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwashi led three hundred skilled archers to hold the pass and rained arrows on the enemy, and the whole army returned safely.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之，賜鈔萬五千緡、金織段三十匹。

translations.literal: The emperor commended him and granted fifteen thousand strings of paper money and thirty bolts of gold brocade.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him and granted fifteen thousand strings of paper money and thirty bolts of gold brocade.

sentences.zh: 海都、朶哇以兵來襲，擊走之。

translations.literal: Qaidu and Duowa came with troops to raid. Yuwashi drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Qaidu and Duowa came with troops to raid, Yuwashi drove them off.

sentences.zh: 武宗鎮北邊，海都復入寇，至兀兒禿，玉哇失敗之，獲其駝馬器仗以獻。

translations.literal: When Wuzong garrisoned the northern frontier, Qaidu invaded again, reaching Wuer Tu. Yuwashi defeated him and presented the camels, horses, and weapons captured.
translations.idiomatic: While Wuzong held the northern frontier, Qaidu invaded again as far as Wuer Tu. Yuwashi defeated him and presented the camels, horses, and weapons taken as booty.

sentences.zh: 時扎魯花赤孛羅帖木兒所將兵為海都困於小谷，帝命玉哇失援出之。

translations.literal: At that time the darughachi Boluotiemur's troops were trapped in a small valley by Qaidu. The emperor ordered Yuwashi to rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the darughachi Boluotiemur's troops were trapped in a small valley by Qaidu, and the emperor ordered Yuwashi to rescue them.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，謂諸將曰：「今日大丈夫之事，舍玉哇失其誰能之，縱以黃金包其身，猶未足以厭朕志。」

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and said to the generals: "For such a man's deed today, apart from Yuwashi who could accomplish it? Even if I wrapped his body in gold, it would still not suffice to satisfy my wish."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was delighted and said to the generals: "For a deed like today's, who but Yuwashi could have done it? Even if I wrapped his body in gold, it would still not be enough to satisfy my wish."

sentences.zh: 武宗南還，命玉哇失後從，敵懼莫敢近，因留之戍邊。

translations.literal: Wuzong returned south and ordered Yuwashi to follow in the rear. The enemy feared him and dared not approach, so he was left to garrison the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong returned south and ordered Yuwashi to follow in the rear. The enemy feared him and dared not approach, so he was left to garrison the frontier.

sentences.zh: 賜以金察剌二，玉束帶、渾金段各一，仍賜秫米七十石，使為酒以犒其軍。

translations.literal: He was granted two gold ceremonial vessels, one jade belt set, one bolt of pure gold brocade, and also granted seventy shi of sorghum to brew wine and reward his army.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted two gold ceremonial vessels, one jade belt set, and one bolt of pure gold brocade, along with seventy shi of sorghum to brew wine and reward his troops.

sentences.zh: 後海都子察八兒等遣人詣闕請和，朝廷許之，遂撤邊備，玉哇失乃還。

translations.literal: Later Qaidu's son Chaba'er and others sent envoys to the court requesting peace. The court granted it, border defenses were withdrawn, and Yuwashi then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qaidu's son Chaba'er and others sent envoys to court to sue for peace. The court agreed, border defenses were withdrawn, and Yuwashi then returned.

sentences.zh: 帝錄其功，賜鈔五萬貫，進鎮國上將軍，仍舊職。

translations.literal: The emperor recorded his achievements, granted fifty thousand strings of paper money, advanced him to General Zhenguo Shang, and retained his former post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor recorded his achievements, granted fifty thousand strings of paper money, promoted him to General Zhenguo Shang, and retained his former post.

sentences.zh: 大德十年五月，晝寢于衛舍，不疾而卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year of the Dade era, he took a daytime nap in the guard quarters and died without illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year of Dade, he took a nap in the guard quarters during the day and died without any prior illness.

sentences.zh: 子亦乞里歹襲。

translations.literal: His son Yiqilidai inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yiqilidai inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 亦乞里歹卒，子拜住襲。

translations.literal: Yiqilidai died, and his son Baizhu inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqilidai died, and his son Baizhu inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 麥里，徹兀臺氏。

translations.literal: Maili was of the Che'utai clan.
translations.idiomatic: Maili was of the Che'utai clan.

sentences.zh: 祖雪里堅那顏，從太祖與王罕戰，同飲班真河水，以功授千戶，領徹里臺部，征討諸國，卒于河西。

translations.literal: His grandfather Xueli Jian Nayan followed Taizu in battle with Wang Han, drank together from the Banzhen River, and for his service was granted a thousand-household command, leading the Cheli Tai tribe in campaigns against various states. He died in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Xueli Jian Nayan followed Taizu in battle against Wang Han and drank together from the Banzhen River. For his service he was granted a thousand-household command and led the Cheli Tai tribe in campaigns against various states. He died in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 父麥吉襲職，從太宗定中原，以疾卒。

translations.literal: His father Maiji inherited the post, followed Taizong in pacifying the Central Plains, and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: His father Maiji inherited the post, followed Emperor Taizong in pacifying the Central Plains, and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 麥里襲職，從定宗略定欽察、阿速、斡魯思諸國。

translations.literal: Maili inherited the post and followed Dingzong in pacifying the Qincha, Asu, and Wolusi states.
translations.idiomatic: Maili inherited the post and followed Emperor Dingzong in pacifying the Qincha, Asu, and Wolusi states.

sentences.zh: 從憲宗伐宋，有功。

translations.literal: He followed Xianzong in the campaign against Song and rendered merit.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Emperor Xianzong in the campaign against Song and distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 探馬赤

translations.literal: Tanmachi
translations.idiomatic: Tanmachi

sentences.zh: 探馬赤，禿立不帶人。

translations.literal: Tanmachi was a Tuli Budai man.
translations.idiomatic: Tanmachi was a Tuli Budai.

sentences.zh: 從諸王沒赤征蜀，後以兵從塔海紺卜、火魯赤、紐璘諸大帥。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Mechi in the campaign against Shu, and later served with troops under the great commanders Tahai Gunbu, Huoluchi, and Niulin.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Mechi in the campaign against Shu, and later served under the great commanders Tahai Gunbu, Huoluchi, and Niulin.

sentences.zh: 歲戊午，紐璘攻涪州，還至馬湖江，宋兵連艦絕江不得進，探馬赤率精兵二千擊之，奪其舟以濟。

translations.literal: In the wuwu year, Niulin attacked Fuzhou. Returning to the Mahu River, Song troops chained their warships across the river blocking passage. Tanmachi led two thousand elite troops to attack them, seized their boats, and crossed.
translations.idiomatic: In the wuwu year Niulin attacked Fuzhou. On the return to the Mahu River, Song troops chained their warships across the river and blocked the crossing. Tanmachi led two thousand elite troops against them, seized their boats, and crossed.

sentences.zh: 又於橫江、嘉定、宣化三縣造浮橋，以達成都，紐璘以為能，命將千人，從萬戶昔力荅略地碉門、黎、雅、土蕃。

translations.literal: He also built pontoon bridges at the three counties of Hengjiang, Jiading, and Xuanhua to reach Chengdu. Niulin considered him capable and ordered him to command one thousand troops, following the myriad-household commander Xilida in subjugating the territories of Diaomen, Li, Ya, and the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: He also built pontoon bridges at Hengjiang, Jiading, and Xuanhua to reach Chengdu. Niulin judged him capable and ordered him to command one thousand troops under the myriad-household commander Xilida in subjugating Diaomen, Li, Ya, and the Tibetan territories.

sentences.zh: 昔力荅死，行院帖赤以探馬赤為萬戶，領其軍。

translations.literal: When Xilida died, Mobile Court Tiechi appointed Tanmachi as myriad-household commander to lead his army.
translations.idiomatic: When Xilida died, Mobile Court Tiechi appointed Tanmachi as myriad-household commander and put him in charge of the army.

sentences.zh: 中統四年，授蒙古漢軍萬戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Zhongtong era, he was appointed Mongol Han Army myriad-household commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhongtong he was appointed commander of the Mongol Han Army myriad-household unit.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，從行省也速帶兒征建都，獨以銳卒千五百人，與建都兵戰于梅子嶺，大敗之，夜馳與速哥會，直擣其營，斬首數十級，生擒百餘人，獲其輜重以歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of the Zhiyuan era, he followed Provincial Administration Yesudai'er in the campaign against Jiandu. With only one thousand five hundred elite troops, he fought Jiandu forces at Meizi Ridge and inflicted a great defeat. That night he rode swiftly to join Suge, struck directly at their camp, beheaded several dozen enemy soldiers, captured more than a hundred alive, and returned with their baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan he followed Provincial Administration Yesudai'er against Jiandu. With only fifteen hundred elite troops he fought the Jiandu army at Meizi Ridge and routed them. That night he rode hard to join Suge, struck straight at their camp, beheaded several dozen men, took more than a hundred prisoners, and returned with their baggage train.

sentences.zh: 復益兵三千人，與左丞曲立吉思乘勝進擊，建都勢蹙，請降。

translations.literal: Reinforced with three thousand more troops, he joined Left Chancellor Qulijisi in pressing the advantage. Jiandu's position became desperate, and they requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforced with three thousand more troops, he and Left Chancellor Qulijisi pressed the attack. Jiandu's position collapsed, and they sued for surrender.

sentences.zh: 又從行院汪田哥、忽敦等，攻嘉定、重慶、瀘、敘諸州，以功兼崇慶府達魯花赤。

translations.literal: He also followed Mobile Court Wang Tiange, Hudun, and others in attacking the prefectures of Jiading, Chongqing, Lu, and Xu. For his service he was concurrently appointed Chief Administrator of Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He also followed Mobile Court Wang Tiange, Hudun, and others in attacking Jiading, Chongqing, Luzhou, and Xuzhou. For his achievements he was also made Chief Administrator of Chongqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十九年卒。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the nineteenth year.

sentences.zh: 子拜延，襲蒙古軍萬戶，戍甘州。

translations.literal: His son Baiyan inherited the Mongol Army myriad-household command and garrisoned Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His son Baiyan inherited the Mongol Army myriad-household command and was stationed at Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 拔都兒

translations.literal: Badou'er
translations.idiomatic: Badou'er

sentences.zh: 拔都兒，阿速氏，世居上都宜興。

translations.literal: Badou'er was of the Asu clan and for generations had lived at Yixing in Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Badou'er was of the Asu clan and his family had long lived at Yixing in Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 憲宗在潛邸，與兄兀作兒不罕及馬塔兒沙帥衆來歸。

translations.literal: While Xianzong was in the latent residence, he came to submit with his elder brother Wuzuo'er Buhan and Mata'ersha, leading their followers.
translations.idiomatic: While Emperor Xianzong was still heir apparent, Badou'er came to submit with his elder brother Wuzuo'er Buhan and Mata'ersha, leading their followers.

sentences.zh: 馬塔兒沙從憲宗征麥各思城，為前鋒將，身中二矢，奮戰拔其城。

translations.literal: Mata'ersha followed Xianzong in the campaign against Maigesi City as vanguard general. Struck by two arrows, he fought fiercely and captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: Mata'ersha followed Emperor Xianzong in the campaign against Maigesi City as vanguard general. Hit by two arrows, he fought on fiercely and took the city.

sentences.zh: 又從征蜀，至釣魚山，歿于軍。

translations.literal: He also followed the campaign against Shu, reaching Diaoyu Mountain, and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He also joined the campaign against Shu, reached Diaoyu Mountain, and died in the field.

sentences.zh: 拔都兒從征李璮，圍濟南，身二十餘戰，世祖嘉其能，賞納失思段九，命領阿速軍一千，常居左右。

translations.literal: Badou'er followed the campaign against Li Tan, besieged Jinan, and personally fought in more than twenty battles. Shizu commended his ability, rewarded him with nine bolts of Nasij brocade, and ordered him to command one thousand Asu troops, keeping him constantly at his side.
translations.idiomatic: Badou'er joined the campaign against Li Tan and besieged Jinan, fighting in more than twenty battles himself. Emperor Shizu praised his ability, rewarded him with nine bolts of Nasij brocade, and put him in command of one thousand Asu troops, keeping him constantly at his side.

sentences.zh: 尋於阿塔赤內充怯薛百戶。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed a keshik centurion within Atach's contingent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed a keshik centurion in Atach's contingent.

sentences.zh: 後從塔不台南征，與敵軍戰于金剛臺，又以功受賞。

translations.literal: Later he followed Tabutai on the southern campaign and fought the enemy at Jingang Platform, again receiving reward for his service.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Tabutai south and fought the enemy at Jingang Platform, again receiving reward for his achievements.

sentences.zh: 師還，言於帝曰：「臣願從軍，為國效死。」

translations.literal: When the army returned, he said to the emperor: "Your subject wishes to follow the army and die in service to the state."
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he said to the emperor: "Your servant wishes to follow the army and give his life for the state."

sentences.zh: 世祖留之，仍命充孛可孫，兼領阿速軍，御馬必令鞚引。

translations.literal: Shizu kept him and again ordered him to serve as bekson, concurrently commanding the Asu army. Whenever the imperial horse was ridden, he was always ordered to hold the bridle.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu kept him and again appointed him bekson while also commanding the Asu army. Whenever the imperial horse was ridden, he was always ordered to hold the bridle.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒

translations.literal: Angji'er
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒，張掖人，姓野蒲氏，世為西夏將家。

translations.literal: Angji'er was a native of Zhangye, surname Yepu, a family that for generations had been military officers of Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er was a native of Zhangye of the Yepu clan, from a family that for generations had served as generals of Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 歲辛巳，父甘卜率所部歸太祖，以其軍隸蒙古軍籍，仍以甘卜為千戶主之。

translations.literal: In the xinsi year, his father Ganbu led his followers in submitting to Taizu. His army was enrolled in the Mongol military register, and Ganbu was still appointed to command the thousand-household unit.
translations.idiomatic: In the xinsi year his father Ganbu led his followers in submitting to Taizu. His troops were enrolled in the Mongol military register, and Ganbu was still appointed to command the thousand-household unit.

sentences.zh: 從木華黎出征，病卒。

translations.literal: He followed Muqali on campaign and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Muqali on campaign and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒領其父軍，從征諸國有功。

translations.literal: Angji'er took command of his father's army and followed campaigns against various states with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er took command of his father's army and distinguished himself in campaigns against various states.

sentences.zh: 至元六年，授本軍千戶，佩金符。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of the Zhiyuan era, he was appointed commander of his thousand-household unit and granted a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhiyuan he was appointed commander of his thousand-household unit and granted a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 俄略地淮南，所向無前。

translations.literal: Soon he subjugated territory south of the Huai River, advancing wherever he went without opposition.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was subjugating territory south of the Huai River and met no resistance wherever he advanced.

sentences.zh: 時國兵初南，塞馬當暑，往往疥癘，昂吉兒以所部馬入太行療之，所病良已。

translations.literal: At that time the national army had just moved south. Northern horses in the summer heat often suffered from scabies and sores. Angji'er took his unit's horses into the Taihang Mountains to treat them, and those afflicted recovered fully.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the imperial army had just moved south. Northern horses in the summer heat often broke out in scabies and sores. Angji'er took his unit's horses into the Taihang Mountains to treat them, and the sick animals recovered completely.

sentences.zh: 由是軍中馬病者，率以屬焉，歲療馬以萬數。

translations.literal: From this, sick horses in the army were generally entrusted to him, and each year he treated horses by the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, sick horses in the army were generally sent to him, and each year he treated tens of thousands of horses.

sentences.zh: 宋輸糧金剛臺，意將深入，昂吉兒將兵馳往，斷其輸道，因上言：「河南邊郡與宋對境，宋兵時為邊患，唐州東南皆大山，信陽在蔡州南，南直九里、武陽、平靖、五水等關，宋兵必經諸關以入，信陽實其咽喉，守禦莫急焉。

translations.literal: Song was transporting grain to Jingang Platform, intending to advance deeply. Angji'er led troops in rapid march, cut off their supply route, and submitted a memorial saying: "The border prefectures of Henan face Song territory, and Song troops often become a border menace. Southeast of Tangzhou are all great mountains. Xinyang lies south of Caizhou, and directly south lie the passes of Jiuli, Wuyang, Pingjing, Wushui, and others. Song troops must pass through these passes to enter. Xinyang is truly their throat; there is no more urgent place to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Song was transporting grain to Jingang Platform, intending to push deeper inland. Angji'er led troops in rapid march and cut their supply line, then submitted a memorial: "Henan's border prefectures face Song territory, and Song troops are a constant border threat. Southeast of Tangzhou lie great mountains. Xinyang is south of Caizhou, and directly south are the passes of Jiuli, Wuyang, Pingjing, Wushui, and others. Song troops must pass through these passes to advance. Xinyang is the choke point, and there is no more urgent place to defend.

sentences.zh: 往年金亡，朝廷得壽、泗、襄、郢，而不留兵守，卒使宋得之，請城信陽，以扼宋。」

translations.literal: In years past when Jin fell, the court took Shou, Si, Xiang, and Ying but left no troops to garrison them, and in the end Song seized them. I request that Xinyang be fortified to choke off Song."
translations.idiomatic: When Jin fell in years past, the court took Shou, Si, Xiang, and Ying but left no troops to hold them, and Song eventually seized them. I ask that Xinyang be fortified to block Song."

sentences.zh: 得旨，令率河西軍一千三百人城之，城成。

translations.literal: He received an imperial order and was commanded to lead one thousand three hundred Hexi troops to build the fort. When the fort was completed—
translations.idiomatic: He received approval and was ordered to lead thirteen hundred Hexi troops to build the fort, which was completed.

sentences.zh: 九年，加明威將軍、信陽軍萬戶，佩虎符，分木華黎及阿朮所將河西兵俾將之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was granted the title General Mingwei and appointed Xinyang Army myriad-household commander with a tiger tally. Hexi troops formerly commanded by Muqali and Azhu were assigned to his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made General Mingwei and Xinyang Army myriad-household commander with a tiger tally, and Hexi troops formerly under Muqali and Azhu were placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 加懷遠大將軍。

translations.literal: He was further granted the title General Huaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was further promoted to General Huaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 丞相伯顏渡江，留阿朮定淮南東道，其西道則屬之昂吉兒，駐兵和州。

translations.literal: When Chancellor Bayan crossed the Yangtze, Azhu was left to pacify the eastern Huainan route, while the western route was assigned to Angji'er, who encamped at Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Chancellor Bayan crossed the Yangtze, Azhu was left to pacify eastern Huainan, while the western route was assigned to Angji'er, who encamped at Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 宋淮西制置夏貴遣侯都統將兵四萬來攻，有謀內應者悉誅之，潛兵出千秋澗，塞其歸路，因出城奮擊，大敗之，獲人馬千計。

translations.literal: Song Huai West Military Commissioner Xia Gui dispatched Commander Hou with forty thousand troops to attack. Those plotting internal collusion were all executed. He secretly sent troops out through Qianqiu Ravine to block their retreat, then sallied from the city in fierce attack and inflicted a great defeat, capturing men and horses by the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Song Huai West Military Commissioner Xia Gui sent Commander Hou with forty thousand troops to attack. Angji'er executed all those plotting to collaborate from within, secretly sent troops out through Qianqiu Ravine to cut off their retreat, then sallied from the city and routed them, capturing men and horses by the thousands.

sentences.zh: 鎮巢軍降，阿速軍戍之，人不堪其橫，都統洪福盡殺戍者以叛。

translations.literal: Zhenchao Army surrendered. Asu troops were stationed to garrison it. The people could not endure their oppression. Commander Hong Fu killed all the garrison troops and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenchao Army surrendered, Asu troops were left to garrison it. The people could not endure their oppression. Commander Hong Fu killed all the garrison troops and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒攻拔其城，擒福及董統制、譚正將。

translations.literal: Angji'er attacked and captured the city, seizing Fu along with Commander Dong and Vice General Tan.
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er attacked and took the city, capturing Fu along with Commander Dong and Vice General Tan.

sentences.zh: 遂攻廬州，夏貴使人來言曰：「公毋吾攻為也，吾主降，吾即降矣。」

translations.literal: He then attacked Luzhou. Xia Gui sent a messenger saying: "Sir, do not trouble yourself to attack us. When my lord submits, I shall submit at once."
translations.idiomatic: He then attacked Luzhou. Xia Gui sent a messenger saying: "Sir, there is no need to attack us. When my lord submits, I shall submit at once."

sentences.zh: 宋亡，貴舉所部納款。

translations.literal: When Song fell, Gui brought his entire command in submission.
translations.idiomatic: When Song fell, Gui brought his entire command in submission.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒入廬州，民按堵無所犯，遷鎮國上將軍、淮西宣慰使。

translations.literal: Angji'er entered Luzhou. The people lived in peace and nothing was violated. He was transferred to General Zhenguo Shang and Huai West Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er entered Luzhou. The people were left undisturbed and nothing was harmed. He was promoted to General Zhenguo Shang and Huai West Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宋丞相文天祥復起兵海道，舒民張德興應之，襲破興國、德安諸郡，還據司空山。

translations.literal: Song Chancellor Wen Tianxiang again raised troops by sea route. Shuzhou native Zhang Dexing responded, raided and captured Xingguo, De'an, and other prefectures, and then held Sikong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Song Chancellor Wen Tianxiang again raised troops by sea. Shuzhou native Zhang Dexing answered the call, raided and captured Xingguo, De'an, and other prefectures, and then held Sikong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 詔昂吉兒攻之，一戰而定，殺張德興，執其三子以獻。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Angji'er to attack him. One battle settled the matter. Zhang Dexing was killed, and his three sons were captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Angji'er to attack him. One battle settled the matter: Zhang Dexing was killed, and his three sons were captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 江左初平，官制草創，權臣阿合馬納賂鬻爵，江南官僚冗濫為甚，郡守而下佩金符者多至三四人，由行省官舉薦超授宣慰使者甚衆，民不堪命。

translations.literal: When the lower Yangtze region was first pacified, the official system was still being created. The powerful minister Ahmad sold offices for bribes. Officialdom in Jiangnan was excessively redundant. Below the level of prefect, as many as three or four persons might wear gold tallies. Many were abruptly promoted to Pacification Commissioner on recommendation of provincial officials. The people could not bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: When the lower Yangtze was first pacified, the official system was still being formed. The powerful minister Ahmad sold offices for bribes, and officialdom in Jiangnan became grossly bloated. Below the prefectural level, as many as three or four men might wear gold tallies, and many were abruptly promoted to Pacification Commissioner on provincial recommendation. The people could not endure the burden.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒入朝，具為帝言之，且枚舉不循資歷而驟陞者數人。

translations.literal: Angji'er came to court and fully reported this to the emperor, also itemizing several persons who had been abruptly promoted without following seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er came to court and reported all of this to the emperor in detail, also naming several men who had been abruptly promoted without proper seniority.

sentences.zh: 帝驚曰：「有是哉！」

translations.literal: The emperor said in alarm: "So it is!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said in alarm: "So it is!"

sentences.zh: 因謂姚樞等曰：「此卿輩所知，而不為朕言，昂吉兒顧言之邪。」

translations.literal: He then said to Yao Shu and others: "This is something you knew but did not tell me. Only Angji'er was willing to speak of it."
translations.idiomatic: He then said to Yao Shu and the others: "This is something you knew but did not tell me. Only Angji'er was willing to speak of it."

sentences.zh: 即命偕平章哈伯、左丞崔斌、翰林承旨和魯火孫、符寶奉御董文忠減汰之，選曹以清。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered Angji'er together with Grand Councillor Habo, Left Chancellor Cui Bin, Hanlin Academician Heluohusun, and Seal and Tally Attendant Dong Wenzong to reduce and eliminate redundant officials. The selection offices were thereby cleared.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered Angji'er, together with Grand Councillor Habo, Left Chancellor Cui Bin, Hanlin Academician Heluohusun, and Seal and Tally Attendant Dong Wenzong, to cut the bloated ranks, and the selection offices were cleared.

sentences.zh: 仍詔諭江淮軍民，俾通知之。

translations.literal: An edict was also issued to inform the military and people of the Jiang-Huai region so they would know of it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was also issued to inform the military and people of the Jiang-Huai region.

sentences.zh: 時兩淮兵革之餘，荊榛蔽野，昂吉兒請立屯田，以給軍餉，帝從之。

translations.literal: At that time, in the aftermath of warfare in the two Huai regions, thorns and brambles covered the fields. Angji'er requested the establishment of military colonies to supply army provisions, and the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, after the warfare in the two Huai regions, thorns and brambles covered the fields. Angji'er requested military colonies to supply army provisions, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 既而阿塔海言：「屯田所用人牛農具甚衆，今方有事日本，若復調發民兵，將不勝動搖矣。」

translations.literal: Soon Atahai said: "Military colonies require very many men, oxen, and farm implements. We now have business with Japan. If we again mobilize militia, the populace will not be able to bear the disruption."
translations.idiomatic: Soon Atahai said: "Military colonies require vast numbers of men, oxen, and farm implements. We now have business with Japan. If we mobilize militia again, the populace will not be able to bear the strain."

sentences.zh: 議遂寢。

translations.literal: The proposal was then shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was then shelved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，宣慰使燕公楠復以為言，帝乃遣數千人，即芍陂、洪澤試之，果如昂吉兒所言，乃以二萬兵屯之，歲得米數十萬斛。

translations.literal: Before long, Pacification Commissioner Yan Gongnan again raised the matter. The emperor then sent several thousand men to test it at Shaopi and Hongze. It proved exactly as Angji'er had said, and twenty thousand troops were stationed there, yielding several hundred thousand hu of rice each year.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Pacification Commissioner Yan Gongnan raised the matter again. The emperor then sent several thousand men to test it at Shaopi and Hongze. It proved exactly as Angji'er had said, and twenty thousand troops were stationed there, yielding several hundred thousand hu of rice each year.

sentences.zh: 加輔國上將軍、河南行省參知政事、淮西宣慰使都元帥，進驃騎衛上將軍、行中書省左丞，加龍虎衛上將軍、行尚書省右丞，兩官皆兼淮西使、帥。

translations.literal: He was granted General Fuguo Shang, Henan Branch Secretariat Associate Administrator, and Huai West Pacification Commissioner Grand Marshal. He was advanced to General Piaoji Guard Shang, Branch Secretariat Left Chancellor, and further to General Longhu Guard Shang, Branch Ministry of Revenue Right Chancellor. Both posts concurrently held the Huai West commissioner and command roles.
translations.idiomatic: He was made General Fuguo Shang, Henan Branch Secretariat Associate Administrator, and Huai West Pacification Commissioner Grand Marshal. He was promoted to General Piaoji Guard Shang and Branch Secretariat Left Chancellor, and further to General Longhu Guard Shang and Branch Ministry of Revenue Right Chancellor, holding both Huai West commissioner and command roles concurrently.

sentences.zh: 日本不庭，帝命阿塔海等領卒十萬征之。

translations.literal: Japan did not attend court. The emperor ordered Atahai and others to lead one hundred thousand troops to campaign against it.
translations.idiomatic: Japan refused to attend court, and the emperor ordered Atahai and others to lead one hundred thousand troops against it.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒上疏，其略曰：「臣聞兵以氣為主，而上下同欲者勝。

translations.literal: Angji'er submitted a memorial, the gist of which was: "Your subject has heard that in warfare morale is paramount, and victory goes to those whose rulers and subjects share the same will.
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er submitted a memorial whose gist was: "Your servant has heard that in warfare morale is paramount, and victory goes to those whose rulers and subjects share the same will.

sentences.zh: 比者連事外夷，三軍屢衂，不可以言氣，海內騷然，一遇調發，上下愁怨，非所謂同欲也，請罷兵息民。」

translations.literal: Recently we have had repeated campaigns against foreign peoples. The Three Armies have suffered repeated defeats, and morale cannot even be spoken of. Within the seas there is unrest. Whenever mobilization is ordered, rulers and subjects alike are filled with resentment. This is not what is meant by sharing the same will. I request that the armies be halted and the people given rest."
translations.idiomatic: Recently we have had repeated campaigns against foreign peoples. The armies have suffered repeated defeats, and morale is gone. The realm is unsettled, and whenever mobilization is ordered, rulers and subjects alike are filled with resentment. This is not what is meant by sharing the same will. I ask that the armies be halted and the people given rest."

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: The request was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 既而師果無功。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the campaign indeed achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the campaign indeed achieved nothing.

sentences.zh: 昂吉兒屢為直言，雖帝怒甚，其辭不少屈。

translations.literal: Angji'er repeatedly spoke bluntly. Even when the emperor was greatly angered, his words did not bend in the least.
translations.idiomatic: Angji'er repeatedly spoke bluntly. Even when the emperor was greatly angered, he did not soften his words in the least.

sentences.zh: 臺臣慮昂吉兒難制，以牙以迷失不畏強禦，奏為本道按察使以察之。

translations.literal: Censorial officials, fearing Angji'er was hard to control, recommended Yiyimishi, who did not fear the powerful, as Intendant of this circuit to investigate him.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials, fearing Angji'er was hard to control, recommended Yiyimishi, who did not fear the powerful, as Intendant of the circuit to investigate him.

sentences.zh: 牙以迷失時捃摭昂吉兒細故以聞，及廷辨，帝察其無他，輒遷其官，後竟以微過罪之。

translations.literal: Yiyimishi constantly collected petty matters against Angji'er and reported them. When the case was argued at court, the emperor saw there was nothing else to it and repeatedly transferred his office. In the end he was punished for a minor fault.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyimishi constantly collected petty matters against Angji'er and reported them. When the case was argued at court, the emperor saw there was nothing else to it and repeatedly transferred his office. In the end Angji'er was punished for a minor fault.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the first year of the Yuanzhen era.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Yuanzhen.

sentences.zh: 子五人，其顯者曰昂阿禿，廬州蒙古漢軍萬戶府達魯花赤；

translations.literal: He had five sons. The prominent ones were Ang'a'tu, Chief Administrator of the Luzhou Mongol Han Army Myriad-Household Command;
translations.idiomatic: He had five sons. The prominent ones were Ang'a'tu, Chief Administrator of the Luzhou Mongol Han Army Myriad-Household Command;

sentences.zh: 曰暗普，海北海南道肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: and Anpu, Surveillance Commissioner of the Haibei Hainan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: and Anpu, Surveillance Commissioner of the Haibei Hainan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 孫教化的，世襲千戶。

translations.literal: His grandson Jiaohuade inherited the thousand-household command.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Jiaohuade inherited the thousand-household command.

sentences.zh: 哈剌，哈魯氏。

translations.literal: Haladai was of the Halu clan.
translations.idiomatic: Haladai was of the Halu clan.

sentences.zh: 初從軍攻襄樊，蒙古四萬戶府辟為水軍鎮撫。

translations.literal: At first he joined the army in the attack on Xiang and Fan. The Mongol Four Myriad-Household Command recruited him as Naval Pacifier.
translations.idiomatic: At first he joined the army in the attack on Xiangyang and Fancheng. The Mongol Four Myriad-Household Command recruited him as Naval Pacifier.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，從丞相伯顏渡江，改管軍百戶，賞甲冑、銀鞘刀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era, he followed Chancellor Bayan in crossing the Yangtze, was changed to command of a hundred-household unit, and was rewarded with armor and a silver-sheathed knife.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan he followed Chancellor Bayan across the Yangtze, was made commander of a hundred-household unit, and was rewarded with armor and a silver-sheathed knife.

sentences.zh: 十二年秋，從丞相阿朮與宋兵戰焦山，敗之，獲海舟二。

translations.literal: In autumn of the twelfth year, he followed Chancellor Azhu in fighting Song troops at Jiaoshan, defeated them, and captured two seagoing vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twelfth year he followed Chancellor Azhu in fighting Song troops at Jiaoshan, defeated them, and captured two seagoing vessels.

sentences.zh: 阿朮與王世強招討造白鷂海船百艘，就四十一萬戶翼摘遣漢軍三千五百、新附軍一千五百，俾哈剌、王世強并統之。

translations.literal: Azhu and Wang Shiqiang, as Pacification Commissioners, built one hundred white-hawk seagoing vessels. From the Forty-One Myriad-Household Wing, three thousand five hundred Han troops and one thousand five hundred newly submitted troops were selected and dispatched, with Haladai and Wang Shiqiang jointly commanding them.
translations.idiomatic: Azhu and Wang Shiqiang, as Pacification Commissioners, built one hundred white-hawk seagoing vessels. From the Forty-One Myriad-Household Wing they selected three thousand five hundred Han troops and one thousand five hundred newly submitted troops and put Haladai and Wang Shiqiang in joint command.

sentences.zh: 攻宋江陰、許浦、金山、上海、崇明、金浦皆下之，獲海船三百餘艘，遂戍澉浦海口。

translations.literal: They attacked Song Jiangyin, Xupu, Jinshan, Shanghai, Chongming, and Jinpu, capturing all of them. More than three hundred seagoing vessels were taken, and they then garrisoned the Kanpu estuary.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Song Jiangyin, Xupu, Jinshan, Shanghai, Chongming, and Jinpu and captured them all. More than three hundred seagoing vessels were taken, and they then garrisoned the Kanpu estuary.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，行省檄充沿海招討副使。

translations.literal: In spring of the thirteenth year, the Branch Secretariat ordered him to serve as Deputy Coastal Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirteenth year the Branch Secretariat appointed him Deputy Coastal Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宋將張世傑舟師至慶元朐山東門海界，哈剌追之，獲船四艘，上其功，行省增撥軍七百并舊所領士卒，守定海港口。

translations.literal: Song general Zhang Shijie's fleet reached the sea boundary east of Qushan Gate in Qingyuan. Haladai pursued them and captured four vessels. He reported his achievement, and the Branch Secretariat added seven hundred troops to his former command to garrison Dinghai Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Song general Zhang Shijie's fleet reached the sea boundary east of Qushan Gate in Qingyuan. Haladai pursued them and captured four vessels. He reported his achievement, and the Branch Secretariat added seven hundred troops to his former command to garrison Dinghai Harbor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，宋昌國州、朐山、秀山戍兵舟師千餘艘，攻奪定海港口，哈剌迎擊，虜其裨將并海船三艘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, more than one thousand Song vessels from Changguo Prefecture and the garrisons of Qushan and Xiushan attacked and seized Dinghai Harbor. Haladai met them in battle and captured their vice general along with three seagoing vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, more than one thousand Song vessels from Changguo Prefecture and the garrisons of Qushan and Xiushan attacked and seized Dinghai Harbor. Haladai met them in battle and captured their vice general along with three seagoing vessels.

sentences.zh: 八月，宋兵復攻定海港口，哈剌擊退之，行省檄充蒙古漢軍招討使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Song troops again attacked Dinghai Harbor. Haladai drove them back, and the Branch Secretariat ordered him to serve as Mongol Han Army Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Song troops again attacked Dinghai Harbor. Haladai drove them back, and the Branch Secretariat appointed him Mongol Han Army Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十月，哈剌引兵至溫州青門，遇宋兵，奪船五艘，遣使諭溫州守臣家之柄以城降。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Haladai led troops to Qingmen in Wenzhou, encountered Song troops, and seized five vessels. He sent envoys to instruct Wenzhou defender Jia Zhibing to surrender the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Haladai led troops to Qingmen in Wenzhou, encountered Song troops, and seized five vessels. He sent envoys to instruct Wenzhou defender Jia Zhibing to surrender the city.

sentences.zh: 十一月，至福州，奪宋海船二十艘，擒毛監丞等。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, he reached Fuzhou, seized twenty Song seagoing vessels, and captured Supervisor Mao and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he reached Fuzhou, seized twenty Song seagoing vessels, and captured Supervisor Mao and others.

sentences.zh: 十四年，賜金符，宣武將軍、沿海招討副使，行省檄充沿海經略副使，俾與劉萬戶行元帥府事於慶元，鎮守沿海上下，南至福建，北趾許浦。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he was granted a gold tally, the title General Xuanwu, and the post of Deputy Coastal Pacification Commissioner. The Branch Secretariat ordered him to serve as Deputy Coastal Military Commissioner, with Myriad-Household Commander Liu to conduct marshal headquarters affairs at Qingyuan, garrisoning the coast from Fujian in the south to Xupu in the north.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was granted a gold tally and made General Xuanwu and Deputy Coastal Pacification Commissioner. The Branch Secretariat appointed him Deputy Coastal Military Commissioner, with Myriad-Household Commander Liu to conduct marshal headquarters affairs at Qingyuan, garrisoning the coast from Fujian in the south to Xupu in the north.

sentences.zh: 六月，行省檄充沿海經略使，兼左副都元帥，督造海船千艘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Branch Secretariat ordered him to serve as Coastal Military Commissioner, concurrently Left Deputy Grand Marshal, supervising the construction of one thousand seagoing vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Branch Secretariat appointed him Coastal Military Commissioner and Left Deputy Grand Marshal, supervising the construction of one thousand seagoing vessels.

sentences.zh: 八月，有旨：江西省右丞塔出等進兵攻廣南，哈剌以兵從。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an imperial order directed Jiangxi Branch Secretariat Right Chancellor Tachu and others to advance troops against Guangnan. Haladai followed with his forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an imperial order directed Jiangxi Branch Secretariat Right Chancellor Tachu and others to advance against Guangnan, and Haladai followed with his troops.

sentences.zh: 十月，進昭勇大將軍、沿海招討使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, he was advanced to General Zhaoyong and Coastal Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was promoted to General Zhaoyong and Coastal Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時宋處州兵復溫州，哈剌歹率兵復取之。

translations.literal: At that time Song troops from Chuzhou recovered Wenzhou. Haladai led troops and recaptured it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Song troops from Chuzhou recovered Wenzhou. Haladai led troops and recaptured it.

sentences.zh: 進至潮陽縣，宋都統陳懿等兄弟五人以畬兵七千人降。

translations.literal: Advancing to Chaoyang County, Song Commander Chen Yi and his four brothers surrendered with seven thousand She troops.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Chaoyang County, Song Commander Chen Yi and his four brothers surrendered with seven thousand She troops.

sentences.zh: 塔出兵攻廣州，踰月未下，哈剌引兵繼至，諭宋安撫張鎮孫、侍郎譚應斗以城降。

translations.literal: Tachu led troops to attack Guangzhou. After more than a month it had not fallen. Haladai led troops to follow up and instructed Song Pacification Commissioner Zhang Zhensun and Vice Minister Tan Yingdou to surrender the city.
translations.idiomatic: Tachu led troops against Guangzhou, but after more than a month it had not fallen. Haladai brought troops up afterward and persuaded Song Pacification Commissioner Zhang Zhensun and Vice Minister Tan Yingdou to surrender the city.

sentences.zh: 從攻張世傑于大洋，獲其軍資器械不可勝計。

translations.literal: He followed in the attack on Zhang Shijie on the open sea and captured military supplies and equipment beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the attack on Zhang Shijie on the open sea and captured military supplies and equipment beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 諭南恩州，宋閤門宣贊、舍人梁國傑以畬軍萬人降。

translations.literal: He instructed Nan'en Prefecture. Song Gate Proclaimer Liang Guojie surrendered with ten thousand She troops.
translations.idiomatic: He persuaded Nan'en Prefecture to submit. Song Gate Proclaimer Liang Guojie surrendered with ten thousand She troops.

sentences.zh: 十五年，還軍慶元。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, the army returned to Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the army returned to Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，入覲，帝問曰：「汝何氏族？」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, he came to audience. The emperor asked: "What is your clan?"
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn he came to audience. The emperor asked: "What is your clan?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣哈魯人。」

translations.literal: He replied: "Your subject is a Halu man."
translations.idiomatic: He replied: "Your servant is a Halu."

sentences.zh: 賜金織文衣、鞍勒，擢昭武大將軍、沿海左副都元帥、慶元路緫管府達魯花赤，將所部軍戍海口。

translations.literal: He was granted gold brocade ceremonial robes and saddle trappings, promoted to General Zhaowu, Left Deputy Coastal Grand Marshal, and Chief Administrator of Qingyuan Circuit General Administration, and ordered to garrison the estuary with his troops.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted gold brocade ceremonial robes and saddle trappings, promoted to General Zhaowu, Left Deputy Coastal Grand Marshal, and Chief Administrator of Qingyuan Circuit, and ordered to garrison the estuary with his troops.

sentences.zh: 十六年，日本商船四艘，篙師二千餘人至慶元港口，哈剌歹諜知其無他，言于行省，與交易而遣之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, four Japanese merchant vessels with more than two thousand boatmen reached Qingyuan Harbor. Haladai spied and learned they meant no harm, reported to the Branch Secretariat, traded with them, and sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year four Japanese merchant vessels with more than two thousand boatmen reached Qingyuan Harbor. Haladai learned through reconnaissance that they meant no harm, reported to the Branch Secretariat, traded with them, and sent them away.

sentences.zh: 海賊賀文達、顧潤等寇掠海島，哈剌歹諭降之，得舟六十餘艘。

translations.literal: Sea bandits He Wenda, Gu Run, and others raided coastal islands. Haladai persuaded them to surrender and obtained more than sixty vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Sea bandits He Wenda, Gu Run, and others raided coastal islands. Haladai persuaded them to surrender and obtained more than sixty vessels.

sentences.zh: 十八年，擢輔國上將軍、都元帥，從國兵征日本，值颶風，舟回。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, he was advanced to General Fuguo Shang and Grand Marshal, followed the national army in the campaign against Japan, encountered a typhoon, and the fleet returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was promoted to General Fuguo Shang and Grand Marshal, joined the imperial army in the campaign against Japan, encountered a typhoon, and the fleet returned.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，還戍慶元。

translations.literal: In the second month of the following year, he returned to garrison Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the following year he returned to garrison Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，罷都元帥，改沿海上萬戶府達魯花赤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the Grand Marshal post was abolished, and he was changed to Chief Administrator of the Coastal Myriad-Household Command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the Grand Marshal post was abolished, and he was made Chief Administrator of the Coastal Myriad-Household Command.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，入朝，帝問日本事宜，哈剌歹應對甚悉，令還戍海道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, he came to court. The emperor asked about Japanese affairs, and Haladai answered in great detail. He was ordered to return and garrison the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he came to court. The emperor asked about Japanese affairs, and Haladai answered in great detail. He was ordered to return and garrison the sea route.

sentences.zh: 授浙東宣慰使，賜金織文段、玉束帶、鞍勒、弓矢有差。

translations.literal: He was appointed Zhedong Pacification Commissioner and granted gold brocade, jade belt sets, saddle trappings, and bows and arrows in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Zhedong Pacification Commissioner and granted gold brocade, jade belt sets, saddle trappings, and bows and arrows in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，樞密以水軍乏帥，奏兼前職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the Privy Council reported that the navy lacked commanders and requested that he concurrently hold his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year the Privy Council reported that the navy lacked commanders and requested that he concurrently hold his former post.

sentences.zh: 冬，徵入見。

translations.literal: In winter, he was summoned to audience.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he was summoned to audience.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜金吾衛上將軍、中書左丞，行浙東道宣慰使，領軍職如故。

translations.literal: The following year, he was appointed General Jinyu Guard Shang, Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and Acting Zhedong Pacification Commissioner, retaining his military command as before.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was made General Jinyu Guard Shang, Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and Acting Zhedong Pacification Commissioner, retaining his military command as before.

sentences.zh: 沙全，哈剌魯氏。

translations.literal: Sha Quan was of the Qarluq clan.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Quan was of the Qarluq clan.

sentences.zh: 父沙的，世居沙漠，從太祖平金，戍河南柳泉，家焉。

translations.literal: His father Shadi had for generations lived in the desert. He followed Taizu in pacifying Jin, garrisoned Liuquan in Henan, and made his home there.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shadi had long lived in the desert. He followed Taizu in pacifying Jin, garrisoned Liuquan in Henan, and settled his family there.

sentences.zh: 全初名抄兒赤，甫五歲，為宋軍所虜，年十八，留劉整幕下，宋人以其父名沙的，使以沙為姓，而名曰全。

translations.literal: Quan was originally named Chao'erchi. At only five years old he was captured by Song troops. At eighteen he remained under Liu Zheng's command. The Song people, because his father's name was Shadi, had him take Sha as his surname and called him Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was originally named Chao'erchi. At the age of five he was captured by Song troops. At eighteen he was serving under Liu Zheng. The Song people, knowing his father's name was Shadi, had him take Sha as his surname and called him Quan.

sentences.zh: 全久居宋，險固備知之。

translations.literal: Quan had long lived in Song territory and knew all the strategic strongpoints.
translations.idiomatic: Having long lived in Song territory, Quan knew every strategic strongpoint.

sentences.zh: 中統二年，整以瀘州來歸，全與之同行，宋軍追之，全力戰得脫，授管軍百戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Zhongtong era, Zheng came to submit with Luzhou. Quan went with him. Song troops pursued them. Quan fought with all his strength and they escaped. He was appointed commander of a hundred-household unit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhongtong, Zheng came over with Luzhou and Quan went with him. Song troops pursued them, but Quan fought with all his strength and they escaped. He was appointed commander of a hundred-household unit.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，整出兵雲頂山，與宋將夏貴兵遇，全擊殺甚衆。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Zhiyuan era, Zheng led troops out from Yunding Mountain and encountered the army of Song general Xia Gui. Quan struck and killed very many.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhiyuan, Zheng led troops out from Yunding Mountain and met the army of Song general Xia Gui. Quan struck and killed a great many.

sentences.zh: 五年，命整領都元帥事，出師圍襄樊，以全為鎮撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Zheng was ordered to take charge of Grand Marshal affairs, led troops out to besiege Xiang and Fan, and Quan was appointed Pacifier.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Zheng was put in charge of Grand Marshal affairs, led troops to besiege Xiangyang and Fancheng, and Quan was appointed Pacifier.

sentences.zh: 整遣全率軍攻仙人山、陳家洞諸寨，破之，陞千戶，賜銀符。
