translations.literal: Zheng dispatched Quan to lead troops in attacking the stockades of Xianren Mountain, Chenjia Cave, and others. They were captured. Quan was promoted to thousand-household commander and granted a silver tally.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng sent Quan to lead troops against the stockades of Xianren Mountain, Chenjia Cave, and others and took them. Quan was promoted to thousand-household commander and granted a silver tally.

sentences.zh: 敗宋將張貴，拔樊城，與劉整軍會。

translations.literal: He defeated Song general Zhang Gui, captured Fancheng, and joined Liu Zheng's army.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Song general Zhang Gui, took Fancheng, and joined Liu Zheng's army.

sentences.zh: 修正陽城，引兵渡淮，與宋將陳安撫戰，敗之。

translations.literal: He repaired Zhengyang City, led troops across the Huai River, fought Song Pacification Commissioner Chen, and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired Zhengyang City, led troops across the Huai River, fought Song Pacification Commissioner Chen, and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 十二年，從丞相阿朮與宋將張世傑、孫虎臣大戰于焦山，水陸並進，宋人不能支，盡棄鼓旗走，獲其將士三十三人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he followed Chancellor Azhu in a great battle with Song generals Zhang Shijie and Sun Huchen at Jiaoshan. Land and sea forces advanced together. Song troops could not hold and abandoned all drums and banners in flight. Thirty-three of their officers and soldiers were captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he followed Chancellor Azhu in a great battle with Song generals Zhang Shijie and Sun Huchen at Jiaoshan. Land and sea forces advanced together. The Song troops could not hold and fled, abandoning all drums and banners. Thirty-three of their officers and soldiers were captured.

sentences.zh: 從攻常州，克之，乘勝下沿海諸城。

translations.literal: He followed in the attack on Changzhou, captured it, and pressed the advantage to take the coastal cities.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the assault on Changzhou, took it, and pressed the advantage to capture the coastal cities.

sentences.zh: 至華亭，戒士卒毋殺掠，遂傾城出降，以功授華亭軍民達魯花赤。

translations.literal: When they reached Huating, he ordered the soldiers not to kill or plunder. The whole city then came out in surrender. For his service he was appointed Chief Administrator of Huating military and civilian affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Huating, he ordered his soldiers not to kill or plunder. The whole city then surrendered. For his achievements he was appointed Chief Administrator of Huating military and civilian affairs.

sentences.zh: 時民心未定，有未附鹽徒聚衆數萬掠華亭，全擊破之，籍其名得六千人，請于行省，遣屯田于淮之芍陂。

translations.literal: At that time popular sentiment was unsettled. Unsubmitted salt smugglers gathered tens of thousands and raided Huating. Quan defeated them, registered their names and obtained six thousand men, requested permission from the Branch Secretariat, and dispatched them to military colonies at Shaopi on the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the people were still unsettled. Unsubmitted salt smugglers gathered in the tens of thousands and raided Huating. Quan defeated them, registered six thousand men by name, sought permission from the Branch Secretariat, and sent them to military colonies at Shaopi on the Huai.

sentences.zh: 行省以邑人新附，時有叛側，委萬戶忽都忽等體察，欲屠其城，全言：「鹽卒多非其土人，若屠之，枉死者衆。」

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat, because the local people had newly submitted and rebellions occurred from time to time, entrusted Myriad-Household Commander Huduhu and others to investigate and intended to slaughter the city. Quan said: "Most of the salt smugglers were not natives of this place. If the city is slaughtered, many innocent people will die wrongly."
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat, because the local people had newly submitted and rebellions occurred from time to time, entrusted Myriad-Household Commander Huduhu and others to investigate and intended to put the city to the sword. Quan said: "Most of the salt smugglers were not natives here. If the city is slaughtered, many innocent people will die wrongly."

sentences.zh: 以死保其不叛，遂止。

translations.literal: He pledged his life to guarantee they would not rebel, and the slaughter was halted.
translations.idiomatic: He pledged his life to guarantee they would not rebel, and the slaughter was halted.

sentences.zh: 賜金符，加武略將軍，兼領鹽場，職如舊。

translations.literal: He was granted a gold tally, given the title General Wulue, and concurrently put in charge of the salt works, his other duties remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted a gold tally, made General Wulue, and put in charge of the salt works as well, his other duties remaining as before.

sentences.zh: 尋陞華亭為府，以全為達魯花赤，賜虎符。

translations.literal: Soon Huating was promoted to a prefecture, and Quan was appointed Chief Administrator with a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Huating was promoted to a prefecture, and Quan was appointed Chief Administrator and granted a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 時盜賊蜂起，其最盛者有衆數千人，全悉招來之，境內得安。

translations.literal: At that time bandits rose everywhere. The largest groups numbered several thousand. Quan summoned them all to submit, and peace was restored within the jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: At that time bandits rose everywhere, the largest groups numbering several thousand. Quan summoned them all to submit, and peace was restored within the jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 改松江萬戶府達魯花赤，始專領軍政。

translations.literal: He was changed to Chief Administrator of the Songjiang Myriad-Household Command and began to hold military and civil authority exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Chief Administrator of the Songjiang Myriad-Household Command and began to hold military and civil authority exclusively.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，召見，遷隆興萬戶府達魯花赤，得請，復舊名曰抄兒赤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, he was summoned to audience and transferred to Chief Administrator of the Longxing Myriad-Household Command. At his request, his original name Chao'erchi was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was summoned to audience and transferred to Chief Administrator of the Longxing Myriad-Household Command. At his request his original name Chao'erchi was restored.

sentences.zh: 未幾，帝以為松江瀕海重地，復命鎮之，賜三珠虎符，卒于官。

translations.literal: Before long, the emperor, considering Songjiang a vital coastal region, again ordered him to garrison it. He was granted a three-pearl tiger tally and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor, considering Songjiang a vital coastal region, again ordered him to garrison it. He was granted a three-pearl tiger tally and died in office.

sentences.zh: 帖木兒不花

translations.literal: Tiemu'erbuhua
translations.idiomatic: Tiemu'erbuhua

sentences.zh: 帖木兒不花，中統初入備宿衛。

translations.literal: Tiemu'erbuhua entered palace guard service at the beginning of the Zhongtong era.
translations.idiomatic: Tiemu'erbuhua entered palace guard service at the beginning of Zhongtong.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，授虎符，代張馬哥為淄萊水軍萬戶，將其衆赴襄陽，與宋將范文虎戰于灌子灘，手殺四十餘人，奪其戰艦，追至雲勝洲，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of the Zhiyuan era, he was granted a tiger tally and replaced Zhang Mage as Zilai Naval Army myriad-household commander. He led his troops to Xiangyang and fought Song general Fan Wenhu at Guanzi Beach. He personally killed more than forty men, seized their warships, pursued to Yunsheng Prefecture, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan he was granted a tiger tally and replaced Zhang Mage as Zilai Naval Army myriad-household commander. He led his troops to Xiangyang and fought Song general Fan Wenhu at Guanzi Beach. He personally killed more than forty men, seized their warships, pursued to Yunsheng Prefecture, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 行省上其功，賜白金五十兩、衣一襲、鞍轡一副。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat reported his achievement. He was rewarded with fifty taels of white gold, one set of robes, and one set of saddle and bridle.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat reported his achievement, and he was rewarded with fifty taels of silver, one set of robes, and one set of saddle and bridle.

sentences.zh: 九年，授益都新軍萬戶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was appointed Yidu New Army myriad-household commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Yidu New Army myriad-household commander.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改益都、淄萊新軍萬戶。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was changed to Yidu and Zilai New Army myriad-household commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was made Yidu and Zilai New Army myriad-household commander.

sentences.zh: 從丞相伯顏伐宋，敗其大將夏貴於陽羅堡。

translations.literal: He followed Chancellor Bayan in the campaign against Song and defeated their great general Xia Gui at Yangluo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Chancellor Bayan in the campaign against Song and defeated their great general Xia Gui at Yangluo Fort.

sentences.zh: 大軍渡江，論其功最多，賜白金五百兩。

translations.literal: When the main army crossed the Yangtze, his achievements were judged the greatest, and he was rewarded with five hundred taels of white gold.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army crossed the Yangtze, his achievements were judged the greatest, and he was rewarded with five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 又從下鄂、蘄、黃、江、建康、常、秀、蘇、杭諸郡，累加昭武大將軍。

translations.literal: He also followed in capturing the prefectures of E, Qi, Huang, Jiang, Jiankang, Chang, Xiu, Su, and Hang, and was repeatedly advanced to General Zhaowu.
translations.idiomatic: He also helped capture the prefectures of E, Qi, Huang, Jiang, Jiankang, Chang, Xiu, Su, and Hang, and was repeatedly promoted to General Zhaowu.

sentences.zh: 從參知政事阿剌罕略定紹興、溫、台、福建諸郡，授台州路緫管府達魯花赤，遷廣東宣慰使。

translations.literal: He followed Associate Administrator Alahan in pacifying the prefectures of Shaoxing, Wen, Tai, and Fujian, was appointed Chief Administrator of Taizhou Circuit General Administration, and was transferred to Guangdong Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Associate Administrator Alahan in pacifying Shaoxing, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and Fujian, was appointed Chief Administrator of Taizhou Circuit, and was transferred to Guangdong Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十六年，加都元帥。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was granted the title Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 追宋將張世傑於香山島，世傑死，降其衆數千人。

translations.literal: He pursued Song general Zhang Shijie to Xiangshan Island. Shijie died, and several thousand of his followers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued Song general Zhang Shijie to Xiangshan Island. Shijie died, and several thousand of his followers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 廣東諸郡及海島盡平，領諸降臣及將校之有功者，入見於大安閣，命太府監視其身，製銀鼠裘成，親賜予之，授中書左丞，行省江西，其餘爵賞有差。

translations.literal: All Guangdong prefectures and coastal islands were pacified. Leading the surrendered officials and meritorious officers and soldiers, he came to audience at the Da'an Pavilion. The emperor ordered the Imperial Storehouse to take his measurements, had a silver-fox fur coat made, and personally granted it to him. He was appointed Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat and Acting Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, with other titles and rewards granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: All Guangdong prefectures and coastal islands were pacified. Leading the surrendered officials and meritorious officers and soldiers, he came to audience at the Da'an Pavilion. The emperor ordered the Imperial Storehouse to take his measurements, had a silver-fox fur coat made, and personally granted it to him. He was appointed Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat and Acting Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, with other titles and rewards granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，拜四川等處行尚書省平章政事，兼緫軍務，改行中書省平章政事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he was appointed Grand Councillor of the Sichuan Branch Ministry of Revenue, concurrently in overall charge of military affairs, and was changed to Grand Councillor of the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed Grand Councillor of the Sichuan Branch Ministry of Revenue with overall charge of military affairs, and was then made Grand Councillor of the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 其兄帖木脫斡，初以蒙古軍千戶從伐蜀有功，行樞密院承制授萬戶。

translations.literal: His elder brother Tiemu'tuwo, at first as Mongol Army thousand-household commander, followed the campaign against Shu with merit. The Mobile Privy Council, by provisional order, granted him the myriad-household command.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Tiemu'tuwo, originally as Mongol Army thousand-household commander, distinguished himself in the campaign against Shu. The Mobile Privy Council provisionally granted him the myriad-household command.

sentences.zh: 并將列別朮、塔海帖木兒、也速帶兒、匣剌撒兒四千戶軍，從大軍攻重慶。

translations.literal: He also commanded the four thousand-household armies of Liebiezhu, Tahai Tiemu'er, Yesudai'er, and Xialasa'er, following the main army in the attack on Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: He also commanded the four thousand-household armies of Liebiezhu, Tahai Tiemu'er, Yesudai'er, and Xialasa'er in the main army's attack on Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 重慶降，收其衆，徇下流諸城，留鎮夔門，兼本路安撫司達魯花赤。

translations.literal: When Chongqing surrendered, he absorbed its forces, swept downstream cities, and was left to garrison Kuimen, concurrently serving as Chief Administrator of the circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: When Chongqing surrendered, he absorbed its forces, swept the downstream cities, and was left to garrison Kuimen while also serving as Chief Administrator of the circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 進懷遠大將軍、蒙古軍萬戶。

translations.literal: He was advanced to General Huaiyuan and Mongol Army myriad-household commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to General Huaiyuan and Mongol Army myriad-household commander.

sentences.zh: 遷定遠大將軍，兼嘉定守鎮萬戶、本路緫管府達魯花赤。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General Dingyuan, concurrently Garrison Myriad-Household Commander of Jiading and Chief Administrator of the circuit General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General Dingyuan, concurrently Garrison Myriad-Household Commander of Jiading and Chief Administrator of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 尋陞鎮國上將軍、諸蠻夷部宣慰使，加都元帥。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to General Zhenguo Shang and Pacification Commissioner of the Various Barbarian Tribes, and granted the title Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to General Zhenguo Shang and Pacification Commissioner of the Various Barbarian Tribes and made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 亦奚不薛蠻畔，與岳剌海會雲南兵討平之。

translations.literal: When the Yixibuxie tribes rebelled, he joined Yuelahai with Yunnan troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yixibuxie tribes rebelled, he joined Yuelahai with Yunnan troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 改征緬都元帥，死于軍。

translations.literal: He was changed to Grand Marshal for the Burma campaign and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Grand Marshal for the Burma campaign and died in the field.

sentences.zh: 子忽都荅兒嗣。

translations.literal: His son Hududa'er inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hududa'er inherited the post.
